Henley praises Rodri's performance in the midfield, particularly highlighting his ability to keep the balance and his crucial role in defensive stability. According to Henley, Rodri's impact is significant, as he contributes to the overall effectiveness of the team's defensive efforts during matches. Rodri's presence and skill in the midfield are seen as key elements that support the team's structure and help maintain control of the game.

```markdown
Henley: Chelsea couldn't break through that City defense at all. Also, Rodri’s performance in midfield really stood out; he was everywhere! His interceptions and passing were key to keeping the momentum up for City.
```

This commentary reflects Henley's positive view of Rodri's midfield contributions and acknowledges the player's essential role in the team's cohesive play, especially in defensive situations.
